ITEM 1 | Cubed pieces, roughly 2-2.5 cm each, golden-brown exterior with crisp, slightly bumpy fried surface and pale cream interior, some pieces with darker browned edges, arranged in a cluster at the left of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Browned meat pieces, irregular chunks about 1.5-2.5 cm, reddish-brown seared exterior with pinkish-red interior visible at cut faces, slightly glossy and juicy, sitting on dark green leafy greens | 80
ITEM 3 | Dark green leafy vegetable, wilted, forming a thin bed under the meat and cubes, small amount visible at lower left and center | 15
ITEM 4 | Sliced fillet pieces, about 6-7 cm long and 2-3 cm wide, pale golden breaded or crusted surface with fine crumb texture and light browning, arranged in overlapping slices on upper right of plate | 150
ITEM 5 | Large piece, about 6 x 4 cm, golden-tan crusted surface with flaky, lightly browned edges, sitting at lower right of plate, partly covered by herb sprigs | 120
ITEM 6 | Fine green herb sprigs, thin wispy stems and needle-like leaves, scattered over the fillet pieces and along the left edge of the plate | 5
